verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־ הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽאָדָ֔ם לָרֹ֖ב עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- hê·ḥêl hā·’ā·ḏām lā·rōḇ ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ yul·lə·ḏū lā·hem
verses.literal: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU que, como os homens começaram a multiplicar-se sobre a face da terra, e lhes nasceram filhas,

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ḇə·nê- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- bə·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·ḏām kî ṭō·ḇōṯ hên·nāh way·yiq·ḥū lā·hem nā·šîm mik·kōl ’ă·šer bā·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful and they took as wives whomever they chose
verses.literalPt: Viram os filhos de Deus que as filhas dos homens eram formosas; e tomaram para si mulheres de todas as que escolheram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא־ יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤י בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְהָי֣וּ יָמָ֔יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh lō- yā·ḏō·wn rū·ḥî ḇā·’ā·ḏām lə·‘ō·lām bə·šag·gam hū ḇā·śār wə·hā·yū yā·māw mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: So the LORD said My Spirit will not contend with man forever for he is mortal his days shall be 120 . . . years
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR: Não contenderá o meu Espírito para sempre com o homem; porque ele também é carne; porém os seus dias serão cento e vinte anos.

verses.original: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָרֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: han·nə·p̄i·lîm hā·yū ḇā·’ā·reṣ bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm wə·ḡam ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·’ū bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- bə·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·ḏām wə·yā·lə·ḏū lā·hem hêm·māh hag·gib·bō·rîm ’ă·šer mê·‘ō·w·lām ’an·šê haš·šêm
verses.literal: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days . . . and afterward as well . . . when the sons of God had relations with . . . the daughters of men And they bore them children who became the mighty men of old men of renown
verses.literalPt: Havia naqueles dias gigantes na terra; e também depois, quando os filhos de Deus entraram às filhas dos homens e delas geraram filhos; estes eram os valentes que houve na antiguidade, os homens de fama.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־ יֵ֙צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar Yah·weh kî rab·bāh rā·‘aṯ hā·’ā·ḏām bā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl yê·ṣer maḥ·šə·ḇōṯ lib·bōw raq ra‘ kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time
verses.literalPt: E viu o SENHOR que a maldade do homem se multiplicara sobre a terra e que toda a imaginação dos pensamentos de seu coração era só má continuamente.

verses.original: וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־ לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yin·nā·ḥem Yah·weh kî- ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām bā·’ā·reṣ way·yiṯ·‘aṣ·ṣêḇ ’el- lib·bōw
verses.literal: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth and He was grieved in His heart
verses.literalPt: Então arrependeu-se o SENHOR de haver feito o homem sobre a terra e pesou-lhe em seu coração.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־ הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּרָ֙אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד־ רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’em·ḥeh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer- bā·rā·ṯî mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh mê·’ā·ḏām ‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh ‘aḏ- re·meś wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim kî ni·ḥam·tî kî ‘ă·śî·ṯim
verses.literal: So the LORD said I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the earth every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air for I am grieved that I have made them
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR: Destruirei o homem que criei de sobre a face da terra, desde o homem até ao animal, até ao réptil, e até à ave dos céus; porque me arrependo de os haver feito.

verses.original: וְנֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·aḥ mā·ṣā ḥên bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Noé, porém, achou graça aos olhos do SENHOR.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו אֶת־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־ נֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ nō·aḥ nō·aḥ ’îš ṣad·dîq tā·mîm hā·yāh bə·ḏō·rō·ṯāw ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hiṯ·hal·leḵ- nō·aḥ
verses.literal: This is the account of Noah Noah . . . was a righteous man blameless in his generation Noah walked with God
verses.literalPt: Estas são as gerações de Noé. Noé era homem justo e perfeito em suas gerações; Noé andava com Deus.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד נֹ֖חַ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת־ שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־ חָ֥ם וְאֶת־ יָֽפֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·leḏ nō·aḥ šə·lō·šāh ḇā·nîm ’eṯ- šêm ’eṯ- ḥām wə·’eṯ- yā·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: And Noah had three sons Shem Ham and Japheth
verses.literalPt: E gerou Noé três filhos: Sem, Cão e Jafé.

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·šā·ḥêṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tim·mā·lê hā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God and full of violence
verses.literalPt: A terra, porém, estava corrompida diante da face de Deus; e encheu-se a terra de violência.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי־ הִשְׁחִ֧ית כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת־ דַּרְכּ֖וֹ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh niš·ḥā·ṯāh kî- hiš·ḥîṯ kāl- bā·śār ’eṯ- dar·kōw ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways
verses.literalPt: E viu Deus a terra, e eis que estava corrompida; porque toda a carne havia corrompido o seu caminho sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·nō·aḥ qêṣ kāl- bā·śār bā lə·p̄ā·nay kî- mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·mās mip·pə·nê·hem wə·hin·nî maš·ḥî·ṯām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then God said to Noah The end of all living creatures has come before Me because through them the earth is full of violence Now behold I will destroy both them and the earth
verses.literalPt: Então disse Deus a Noé: O fim de toda a carne é vindo perante a minha face; porque a terra está cheia de violência; e eis que os desfarei com a terra.

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת עֲצֵי־ גֹ֔פֶר קִנִּ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה וְכָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛הּ מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ בַּכֹּֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh lə·ḵā tê·ḇaṯ ‘ă·ṣê- ḡō·p̄er qin·nîm ta·‘ă·śeh ’eṯ- hat·tê·ḇāh wə·ḵā·p̄ar·tā ’ō·ṯāh mib·ba·yiṯ ū·mi·ḥūṣ bak·kō·p̄er
verses.literal: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out
verses.literalPt: Faze para ti uma arca da madeira de gofer; farás compartimentos na arca e a betumarás por dentro e por fora com betume.

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑הּ שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’am·māh ’ō·reḵ hat·tê·ḇāh ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯāh
verses.literal: And this is how you are to build it The ark is to be 300 . . . cubits long 50 cubits wide and 30 cubits high
verses.literalPt: E desta maneira a farás: De trezentos côvados o comprimento da arca, e de cinqüenta côvados a sua largura, e de trinta côvados a sua altura.

verses.original: צֹ֣הַר׀ תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַתֵּבָ֗ה וְאֶל־ אַמָּה֙ תְּכַלֶ֣נָּה מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וּפֶ֥תַח הַתֵּבָ֖ה בְּצִדָּ֣הּ תָּשִׂ֑ים תַּחְתִּיִּ֛ם שְׁנִיִּ֥ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·har ta·‘ă·śeh lat·tê·ḇāh wə·’el- ’am·māh tə·ḵa·lɛn·nå̄h mil·ma‘·lāh ū·p̄e·ṯaḥ hat·tê·ḇāh bə·ṣid·dāh tā·śîm taḥ·tî·yim šə·nî·yim ū·šə·li·šîm ta·‘ă·śe·hā
verses.literal: You are to make a roof for the ark finish its walls a cubit from the top place a door in the side of the ark and build lower middle and upper decks
verses.literalPt: Farás na arca uma janela, e de um côvado a acabarás em cima; e a porta da arca porás ao seu lado; far-lhe-ás andares, baixo, segundo e terceiro.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת־ הַמַּבּ֥וּל מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־ בּוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ- ham·mab·būl ma·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ša·ḥêṯ kāl- bā·śār ’ă·šer- bōw rū·aḥ ḥay·yîm mit·ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·mā·yim kōl ’ă·šer- bā·’ā·reṣ yiḡ·wā‘
verses.literal: And behold I will bring floodwaters . . . upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life Everything on the earth will perish
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que eu trago um dilúvio de águas sobre a terra, para desfazer toda a carne em que há espírito de vida debaixo dos céus; tudo o que há na terra expirará.

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֛יךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֥ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇā·ṯā ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·’iš·tə·ḵā ū·nə·šê- ḇā·ne·ḵā ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: But I will establish My covenant with you and you will enter . . . the ark you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you
verses.literalPt: Mas contigo estabelecerei a minha aliança; e entrarás na arca, tu e os teus filhos, tua mulher e as mulheres de teus filhos contigo.

verses.original: וּמִכָּל־ הָ֠חַי מִֽכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mik·kāl- hā·ḥay mik·kāl bā·śār šə·na·yim mik·kōl tā·ḇî ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh lə·ha·ḥă·yōṯ ’it·tāḵ zā·ḵār ū·nə·qê·ḇāh yih·yū
verses.literal: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark male and female to keep them alive with you
verses.literalPt: E de tudo o que vive, de toda a carne, dois de cada espécie, farás entrar na arca, para os conservar vivos contigo; macho e fêmea serão.

verses.original: מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: mê·hā·‘ō·wp̄ lə·mî·nê·hū ū·min- hab·bə·hê·māh lə·mî·nāh mik·kōl re·meś hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lə·mî·nê·hū šə·na·yim mik·kōl yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature . . . will come to you to be kept alive
verses.literalPt: Das aves conforme a sua espécie, e dos animais conforme a sua espécie, de todo o réptil da terra conforme a sua espécie, dois de cada espécie virão a ti, para os conservar em vida.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֗ מִכָּל־ מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qaḥ- lə·ḵā mik·kāl ma·’ă·ḵāl ’ă·šer yê·’ā·ḵêl wə·’ā·sap̄·tā ’ê·le·ḵā wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵā wə·lā·hem lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals
verses.literalPt: E leva contigo de toda a comida que se come e ajunta-a para ti; e te será para mantimento, a ti e a eles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś nō·aḥ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm kên ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: So Noah did everything precisely as . . . God had commanded him
verses.literalPt: Assim fez Noé; conforme a tudo o que Deus lhe mandou, assim o fez.
